relationships.subject: Propionic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with exogenous PA supplementation alleviated pain and inhibited inflammation in the intestine and spinal cord, including NLRP3 inflammasome and NF-κB activation.

relationships.subject: Astaxanthin
relationships.evidence_quote: AST treatment modulated the gut microbiota, elevated PA levels, reduced inflammation, and strengthened the intestinal barrier, exerting an analgesic effect.

key_findings: Spinal nerve ligation reduces propionic acid in feces, serum and spinal cord; PA supplementation relieves pain and suppresses NLRP3/NF-κB activation
Astaxanthin raises PA levels, modulates gut microbiota and strengthens the intestinal barrier, producing analgesia
